name: Sara Pinto Coelho
contribution: A writer of fiction, plays and children's literature, as well as being a primary school teacher and, later, a radio theatre director.

checks.lead: Sarah Augusta de Lima Abreu Pinto Coelho, better known as Sara Pinto Coelho (1913 in Portuguese São Tomé and Príncipe – 1990 in Portugal), was a writer of fiction, plays and children's literature, as well as being a primary school teacher and, later, a radio theatre director.
